summary.text: Tiffanie Arthur is the Democratic candidate for Indiana House of Representatives District 63 in the November 3, 2026 general election. She is a small business owner.

paragraphs.text: Tiffanie Arthur graduated from North Daviess High School and works as a small business owner.
In a Ballotpedia survey, she described herself as a small business owner, a mother and part of a farm family with deep roots in her community.
Arthur advanced from the Democratic primary on May 5, 2026.

She said her campaign priorities include funding for public schools and policies for rural Indiana, such as supporting family farms, protecting agricultural land, expanding broadband and maintaining roads and bridges.
